description: Price a selected stay for exact dates and guest count using backend fees, payment schedule, and estimate and confirmation flags. May return checkoutUrl and continue_url for the existing checkout; these can be null and do not authenticate, reserve or pay. Checkout still requires sign-in and current validation. Reprice after changing dates, guests or rate code.

checkIn.description: Local arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with no time or UTC conversion. Supply checkOut too.

checkOut.description: Local departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format, after checkIn and at most 366 nights later. Checkout day is not an occupied night. Supply checkIn too.

discountCode.description: Preferred-rate code supplied by the guest. Pricing trims and uppercases it, then checks eligibility; search only retains it as context.

guests.description: Number of guests to price, from 1 to 100. Search and comparison declare guests as a string; either form is accepted by every tool. Listing capacity is checked by checkout.

slug.description: Public listing slug from a Hyatus search result or listing URL, not an internal ID or full URL.

stayLength.description: Stay length in nights as a whole-number string from '1' to '366'. Retained as stay context; explicit checkIn/checkOut determine the priced dates.

name: price_hyatus_stay
title: Estimate a stay price
